dct_description_sm: This dataset includes the following variables and respective units: Date (dd-mm-yyyy), depth (m), zooplankton abundance (individuals m-3), zooplankton biomass (mg DW m-3), microbial abundance (cells L-1), microbial biomass (μg C L-1), temperature (°C), clear ice (cm), snow ice (cm), total ice (cm), snow (cm), secchi (m), specific conductivity (μS cm-1), dissolved oxygen saturation (%), dissolved oxygen concentration (mg L-1), seston chlorophyll-a (mg L-1), photosynthetically active radiations – PAR (μmol quanta cm-2 s-1).

This dataset includes limnological and biological data from 5 depths under the ice of boreal lake Simoncouche during winter 2020-2021, as well as the respective overturns where sampling was conducted on integrated water column. In addition are included data from two long-term under-ice moored multisensors (1.5 m and 6 m depth) recording measurements of temperature, light, specific conductivity and oxygen concentration, for which the daily mid-day values were selected in the file "long_term_rbr". Included information covers zooplankton abundance (zoopl_abund) and biomass (zoopl_biom) per taxa, bacteria, picoplankton, and nanoflagellates abundance and biomass (microbes_abund_biom), and physico-chemical variables (phys_chem_data; long_term_rbr).
dct_title_s: Plankton abundance and biomass at five depths in Lake Simoncouche (Saguenay, Quebec, Canada) during winter 2020-2021
